name: breast mass overview
title: Breast mass decision chart: after checking for cancer emergencies, history and exam, the feel of the lump sorts benign causes (cyst or fibrocystic change, abscess, fibroadenoma) from breast cancer; each column gives the feel, the test that clinches it and what follows

root.title: Breast mass: BENIGN or MALIGNANT?
lines: 1 · STABLE? check for cancer EMERGENCIES first: cord compression, superior vena cava obstruction, hypercalcemia, febrile neutropenia
2 · History + exam: where (clock face, depth), size, edge, consistency, mobility · nipple, skin, nodes, the other breast
3 · Image: ULTRASOUND first for a palpable lump, pain, discharge or age < 30 · then diagnostic mammogram
older = more likely cancer · NO blood or urine test identifies a breast mass

groups.title: BENIGN feel
lines: SMOOTH edge · MOBILE · soft or firm · CHANGES with periods · may be tender

groups.title: MALIGNANT feel
lines: IRREGULAR · HARD · may be FIXED · usually painless · CONSTANT

columns.drop_label: smooth · or lumpy with the cycle
head: h
Cyst · fibrocystic change
NOT a neoplasm
feel: sac of fluid, air or semi-solid
tenderness VARIES with the menstrual cycle
test: Fine needle aspiration (FNA, 22 G or finer)

head: h
Abscess
infection: often mastitis while breastfeeding
next: Looks infected? INFLAMMATORY CANCER can mimic it

head: h
Breast cancer
rare in men (think gynecomastia)
feel: • B symptoms: fever, night sweats, weight loss
URGENT: cancer in the skin or lymphatics
• PEAU D'ORANGE: dimpled like an orange
test: Needle CORE biopsy (21 G or larger)
SHOWS INVASION: a fine needle cannot
next: • full-body CT: NEVER for workup or screening
